result.summary: No critical breakage, but found 1 major questionable promo label and 2 minor visual inconsistencies with button styling and time formatting.

issues.description: Second card in 'Popular right now' shows '-100%' badge which looks like a data or promo logic error implying free food
issues.suggestion: Verify discount data source; if intended as free item show as 'Free' or '100% off' with proper rules, otherwise correct percentage value

issues.description: Favorite heart button styling is inconsistent: Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows white outline heart directly on image with no circular background, while pizza card below shows white heart inside dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Use consistent favorite button style with semi-transparent dark circular background on all cards for visibility and tap target clarity

issues.description: Delivery time badge formatting is inconsistent in 'Fastest near you' row: '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' without spaces vs '20-30 min' with spaces around hyphen
issues.suggestion: Standardize to single format e.g. '15–25 min' across all restaurant cards
